reason: Repair reviewed demo/publication readiness finding from retained readiness spec.

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: One documented command emits a structurally complete Runtime-produced birthday packet.
AC-2: Startup, wake, restore, snapshot, admission, copied state, simulation, named fixture, and missing-evidence cases reject with typed reasons.
AC-3: Replay, interruption, redaction, and separate native macOS and Linux packet validation pass with allowed nondeterminism declared and pinned receipts.
AC-4: D1-D6, PUBLIC_LAUNCH_COPY_v0.92.md, REVIEWER_FAQ_AND_CLAIM_BOUNDARY_v0.92.md, and the reviewer index cite exact commands, artifacts, and revisions without publication overclaim.

AC-5: A machine-readable publication-gate checklist rejects missing accepted witness/receipt proof, stale review, unsupported claims, unresolved negatives, or absent operator authorization and cannot publish.
AC-6: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.

steps.action: Verify all WP-18 dependency revisions, schemas, and commands
Implement the integrated positive runner and deterministic packet validator
Implement and retain the complete not-a-birthday matrix
Run replay, interruption, redaction, separate native macOS and Linux, and D1-D6 artifact checks
Reconcile both canonical launch documents and validate the fail-closed publication-gate checklist
Resolve exact-head review and retain the reviewer index

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove the integrated Runtime emits one complete birthday packet.
Prove all not-a-birthday, interruption, replay, and redaction cases fail closed.
Run the packet contract on a native macOS host and pin host class, source revision, argv, result, and artifact digests.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Requires a native macOS runner; absence or a non-native substitute blocks readiness.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Run the packet contract on a native Linux host and pin host class, source revision, argv, result, and artifact digests.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Requires a native Linux runner; absence or a non-native substitute blocks readiness.
